title: Unarmored threespine sticklebacks swim and feed after being rereleased into the wild (34207922946)
description: ANGELES NATIONAL FOREST, Calif. (April 14, 2017) - Unarmored threespine sticklebacks swim and feed after being rereleased into the wild. A team of biologists and scientists from USFWS and CDFW rereleased 151 unarmored threespine sticklebacks into the creek April 14, after conducting an emergency rescue of the fish late last year in response to a fire that threatened their habitat. Video by Robyn Gerstenslager/USFWS.
